```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# install.packages(c("data.table", "lubridate"))
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)

# 0) 读入（用fread很快）
login <- fread("player_logged_in.csv")      # pid, EventName, Time, Time_utc
js    <- fread("job_started.csv")
jc    <- fread("job_completed.csv")
je    <- fread("job_exited.csv")
tc    <- fread("task_completed.csv")       # 可选，用于更细颗粒完成感

# 1) 统一时间字段：优先用 Time_utc（你文件里有 Time 和 Time_utc）
to_dt <- function(DT) {
  DT[, Time_utc := ymd_hms(Time_utc, tz="UTC")]
  DT
}
login <- to_dt(login)
js    <- to_dt(js)
jc    <- to_dt(jc)
je    <- to_dt(je)
tc    <- to_dt(tc)

# 2) 定义 t=0：每个玩家第一次登录时间（first_login_time）
players_base <- login[, .(t0 = min(Time_utc)), by = pid]

# 3) 设定 early window（建议先用60分钟）
EARLY_MIN <- 60
early_cut <- function(DT) {
  DT <- merge(DT, players_base, by="pid", all.x=TRUE)
  DT[, t_since_start_min := as.numeric(difftime(Time_utc, t0, units="mins"))]
  DT[t_since_start_min >= 0 & t_since_start_min <= EARLY_MIN]
}

js_early <- early_cut(js)
jc_early <- early_cut(jc)
je_early <- early_cut(je)
tc_early <- early_cut(tc)  # 可选

# 4) Treatment：early positive-feedback density
#   用 job_completed 的数量 / 60分钟
treat <- jc_early[, .(
  jobs_completed_early = .N,
  early_feedback_density = .N / EARLY_MIN,
  # 可选：平均完成间隔（分钟）
  mean_gap_min = {
    tt <- sort(Time_utc)
    if (length(tt) <= 1) NA_real_ else mean(diff(as.numeric(tt))/60)
  }
), by = pid]

# 5) Confounder 1：initial engagement（用 job_started）
eng <- js_early[, .(
  jobs_started_early = .N,
  # 你表里有 CurrentSessionLength（看起来是分钟，需确认，但可先用）
  session_len_sum_early = sum(as.numeric(CurrentSessionLength), na.rm=TRUE),
  session_len_max_early = max(as.numeric(CurrentSessionLength), na.rm=TRUE)
), by = pid]

# 6) Confounder 2：initial skill proxy（用 job_exited + job_completed）
#   思路：早期退出率/稳定性、早期完成速度等
skill_exit <- je_early[, .(
  jobs_exited_early = .N,
  credit_mean_early = mean(as.numeric(CurrentCreditAmount), na.rm=TRUE),
  level_prog_mean_early = mean(as.numeric(LevelProgressionAmount), na.rm=TRUE)
), by = pid]

# 一个简单的“完成速度”proxy：早期完成事件的平均 session length（仅作proxy，谨慎解释）
skill_comp <- jc_early[, .(
  session_len_at_completion_mean = mean(as.numeric(CurrentSessionLength), na.rm=TRUE),
  campaign_prog_mean = mean(as.numeric(CampaignProgressionAmount), na.rm=TRUE)
), by = pid]

# 合并 confounders
conf <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x,y,by="pid",all=TRUE),
               list(eng, skill_exit, skill_comp))

# 7) Outcome：Retention 7/14/30 天
#   定义：在 t0 + k天 之后是否还出现任何事件（任意表都算）
#   做法：把几个事件表的时间拼起来取 max_time
all_events <- rbindlist(list(
  login[, .(pid, Time_utc)],
  js[,    .(pid, Time_utc)],
  jc[,    .(pid, Time_utc)],
  je[,    .(pid, Time_utc)],
  tc[,    .(pid, Time_utc)]
), use.names=TRUE)

max_t <- all_events[, .(t_last = max(Time_utc)), by=pid]
out <- merge(players_base, max_t, by="pid", all.x=TRUE)

out[, retention_7d  := as.integer(t_last >= t0 + days(7))]
out[, retention_14d := as.integer(t_last >= t0 + days(14))]
out[, retention_30d := as.integer(t_last >= t0 + days(30))]

out <- out[, .(pid, retention_7d, retention_14d, retention_30d)]

# 8) 拼最终 analysis_table
analysis <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x,y, by="pid", all=TRUE),
                   list(players_base[, .(pid)], treat, conf, out))

# 9) 最小清理：去掉没有“暴露”的玩家（例如 early window 内 started 太少）
analysis <- analysis[!is.na(jobs_started_early) & jobs_started_early >= 1]

# 10) 可选：winsorize（1%-99%）避免极端值影响
winsor <- function(x, p=c(0.01,0.99)) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs=p, na.rm=TRUE)
  pmin(pmax(x, q[[1]]), q[[2]])
}
for (v in c("early_feedback_density","jobs_started_early","jobs_exited_early",
            "session_len_sum_early","session_len_at_completion_mean")) {
  if (v %in% names(analysis)) analysis[, (v) := winsor(get(v))]
}

# 输出
fwrite(analysis, "analysis_table_player_level.csv")

```
